reason: Six audit findings in the reporting/export/artifact path. (22) request_render assembled the canonical snapshot, which SHA-256 hashes every referenced artifact, synchronously on the event loop while holding the render lock, and the PDF download route re-hashed the PDF on the loop; snapshot assembly and the cached-render check now run in _prepare_render via asyncio.to_thread outside the lock, and the route offloads pdf(). (23) exporter's elif chain made the harness_profile_id branch unreachable for an AgentRun that also had a supervisor provider, so the bundle omitted the harness profile; both references are now collected. (26) sign-off wrote report_revision N into the report metadata but N+1 into the audit event, and validated findings outside the committing transaction so a finding deleted or invalidated between check and commit produced a 404 or was finalized; sign-off now records the signed revision consistently, opens the write transaction first (BEGIN IMMEDIATE on SQLite, matching delete_archived_engagement) and re-validates every finding inside it, reporting a deleted finding as a ConflictError. (28) _build_pdf appended one distinct glyph warning per field, unbounded against ReportRender.warnings max_length=1000, so a large multilingual report could fail its completion update after the PDF was written; unsupported code points are now aggregated into one bounded warning. (29) ArtifactStore.verify raised ArtifactStoreError for a row whose storage_path escapes the store or disagrees with its digest, so the render's structured artifact_integrity 409 became a 500; verify now records the exception and returns False. (38) blob writes fsynced the file but never the shard directory after os.link, so a crash could leave the committed Artifact row without its blob; the directory (and newly created parent shards) are fsynced after the link. Proven by the nine new tests in the listed files, each of which fails on origin/main, plus the existing suites in those files; the existing rollback test now injects its failure into StoreTransaction.append_operation_event because sign-off no longer goes through update_with_operation_event.
exclusions: No frontend tests: no ui/ change. No native tests: no Tauri or Rust change. No Playwright: area:core-api (the real-Core journey suite matched through api.py) does not exercise report sign-off revision metadata, PDF hashing threads, exporter harness references, artifact verify on corrupt rows or blob fsync; the Python tests drive them directly. No full suites.
